summary: This is a Makefile that sets up a help system for running various development tasks. It defines shell variables, creates a help command that displays all available targets organized by category, and then lists several development tasks like opening a bash shell, running code analysis tools, and managing the database.

explanations.1: SHELL:=bash sets which shell interpreter (bash) will be used to execute commands in this Makefile instead of the default sh.
explanations.3: COLOR_YELLOW:=33 defines a variable storing the ANSI color code for yellow text, though it's not actually used in this snippet.
explanations.5: .PHONY: help tells Make that 'help' is not a real file to build, but a command to run.
explanations.7: @clear runs the clear command silently (the @ symbol suppresses showing the command itself in output).
explanations.8: This awk command parses the Makefile itself to extract and pretty-print all the help text: it finds lines ending with ## comments, formats them with colors, and groups them by ##@ category headers.
explanations.12: ##@ creates a category header called 'My project' that will appear in the help output; everything after the second @ until the end of line is the description shown.
explanations.14: .PHONY: bash marks 'bash' as a command target rather than a file.
explanations.19: ##@ creates another category header 'Data quality' to group the code analysis commands that follow.
explanations.30: ##@ creates a third category header 'Database management' for database-related commands.
